Roles & Responsibilities
Love sports, sneakers and an active lifestyle? Turn your passion into a rewarding retail career!
We are hiring energetic and customer-oriented Retail Associates to join a leading international sportswear and lifestyle retail environment at Jurong East and Changi.
💰 Salary & Benefits
Basic Salary: $2,300–$2,500/month
Attractive individual and/or team commissions
Indicative monthly commission: $1,000–$2,000
Potential total earnings of up to $4,500/month, depending on sales performance and commission
AWS and performance bonuses
Public holiday and overtime pay
Retail training and development opportunities
🛍️ Key Responsibilities
Deliver excellent customer service and create a positive shopping experience
Promote sportswear, footwear and lifestyle products to drive sales
Achieve individual and store sales targets and KPIs
Assist customers with product recommendations, sizing and purchases
Maintain attractive product displays and store visual merchandising standards
Handle stock replenishment, incoming and outgoing merchandise
Support daily store operations, including opening and closing duties
Maintain store cleanliness, safety and organisation
🎯 Job Requirements
1–2 years of retail or customer service experience, preferably in apparel, footwear or sportswear
Passion for sports, fitness, sneakers or an active lifestyle
Energetic, approachable and customer-focused
Good communication skills and a strong team player
Quick learner with a positive, sales-driven attitude
Basic computer literacy and MS Office knowledge
Physically fit and comfortable with regular lifting and carrying of merchandise
📍 Work Locations
near Jurong East MRT
near Changi (EXPO) MRT
Interested candidates, apply now!
📧 Email your updated resume to nynn.peck@crew.sg
📱 WhatsApp: +65 9488 7221
Please include your availability, current/last drawn salary and expected salary.
Only shortlisted candidates will be notified.
